fallback_reason: AI4Bharat Indic-TTS uses FastPitch + HiFi-GAN (PyTorch), not VITS. No pre-converted ONNX models available for Indic TTS in sherpa-onnx ecosystem.

swap_in_path.description: To use sherpa-onnx TTS instead of platform TTS:
steps: 1. Convert AI4Bharat Indic-TTS (FastPitch + HiFi-GAN) to ONNX
2. Use sherpa-onnx OfflineTts API with VITS config
3. Alternative: Meta MMS-TTS (already has ONNX exports for Indic)

notes.platform_tts_quality: Acceptable for demo — Android ships Indic language TTS voices in most OEM builds
notes.production_target: sherpa-onnx VITS with AI4Bharat or Meta MMS-TTS models
